Terminator review

14 proposals with example data. The last four rows illustrate code behavior from source review.

SuggestionBeforeAfter
Narrow Settings

Use one section menu when the card is narrow. This gives the form more height while keeping search visible.

Settings search

Match each setting on its own. A search for “Local History MiB” should show the size control even when the days setting does not match.

Git commit guidance

When files are staged and the message is empty, show “Write a commit message” beside the staged count. Keyboard users can see how to enable Commit.

Status bar

Use a compact indicator for a healthy connection. Show language server problems when they occur. Give the active filename the extra space.

Carbon active tab

Use a brighter title and a thicker underline on the active tab. Keep errors identifiable by their icon and text.

Agents inbox

Give Open terminal and Peek visible labels. Put the other card actions in the menu. Peek lets the user read the screen without leaving the inbox.

Find in Files filters

Put File mask and Exclude behind Filters. When a filter is active, show its value beside the query so the search scope stays visible.

Project tree names

Use the workspace tab title for an unnamed group. Keep custom names and the group icon so users can distinguish a group from its files.

Close a workspace tab

Show the tab name and list its live sessions. Close tab leaves the sessions running. Stop 2 sessions names the action and its scope.

Remove several worktrees

List each selected branch and checkout path. Include the count in the Remove button and say that Git keeps the branches.

Replace All and stale results

Save a fingerprint of each whole file during search. Check it before staging edits. If any file changed, stop the entire replacement and refresh the results.

Cancel a flow during launch

Check for cancellation before each step launch and again after worktree setup, before terminal creation. Leave running sessions alone.

Local History watch failures

Track a project as watched only after registration succeeds. Show the failed folder and retry after a delay.

Replace in Files edit limit

Enforce the 4,096-edit limit while collecting matches. Calculate UTF-16 columns in one forward pass to avoid repeated scans of a long line.
